mapper.select: SELECT slot_id AS id, available_time AS time, status, max_capacity AS maxCapacity, booked_count AS bookedCount FROM time_slots WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations (member_id, post_id, slot_id, adult_count, child_count, request, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{dto.postId}, #{dto.slotId}, #{dto.adultCount}, #{dto.childCount}, #{dto.request}, 'PENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE time_slots SET booked_count = booked_count + #{count}, status = CASE WHEN booked_count + #{count} >= max_capacity THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE status END WHERE slot_id = #{slotId}
mapper.sql: r.id, r.post_id AS postId, p.title AS postTitle, r.member_id AS requesterId, r.member_id AS memberId, p.user_id AS guideId, r.slot_id AS slotId, ps.available_date AS slotDate, ts.available_time AS slotTime, r.adult_count AS adultCount, r.child_count AS childCount, r.request, r.status, r.created_at AS createdAt
FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN posts p ON r.post_id = p.post_id LEFT JOIN time_slots ts ON r.slot_id = ts.slot_id LEFT JOIN post_schedules ps ON ts.schedule_id = ps.schedule_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.user_id FROM reservations r JOIN posts p ON r.post_id = p.post_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
